```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(melbairbnbexplore)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Intended User & Research Question

**User:** Prospective Airbnb host in Melbourne deciding where to buy/rent and what property type to list.

**Question:** How do location (Council Area/LGA) and property type (room_type) affect nightly price?

## Data Source & Cleaning

**Source:** InsideAirbnb Melbourne 2026-09-16 (25k listings). Raw 90 cols in data-raw/ (gitignored). Cleaned to 5 cols in data/melb_airbnb.rda via data-raw/melb_airbnb_raw.R - price string to numeric, filtered 0-1000, neighbourhood_cleansed used as neighbourhood which for Melbourne is LGA (Banyule, Bayside etc.)

**Cleaning in `data-raw/melb_airbnb_raw.R`:**
1. `clean_names()` to standardise columns
2. Used `neighbourhood_cleansed` as `neighbourhood` - for Melbourne this is LGA/Council (Banyule, Bayside etc.), not suburb. Real suburb column is 90% empty.
3. Selected 5 relevant cols: neighbourhood, room_type, price, number_of_reviews, review_scores_rating
4. Cleaned price `"$250.00"` -> `250` numeric
5. Filtered `price >0 & price <1000` to remove outliers and missing LGAs

```{r}
head(melb_airbnb)
glimpse(melb_airbnb)
```

**Note:** Melbourne InsideAirbnb uses Local Government Area as location proxy. We document this as Council Area throughout app.

## Package Functions

### `summarise_prices()`

Summarises average price by council and room type - core for host pricing strategy.

```{r}
summarise_prices(melb_airbnb)
```

Entire home/apt is ~2x Private room, as expected.

### Top 10 Most Expensive Council Areas

```{r}
melb_airbnb |>
  group_by(neighbourhood) |>
  summarise(avg_price = mean(price, na.rm=TRUE), n=n()) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_price)) |>
  head(10) |>
  ggplot(aes(reorder(neighbourhood, avg_price), avg_price)) +
  geom_col(fill="#69b3a2") + coord_flip() +
  labs(x="Council Area (LGA)", y="Avg Price AUD", 
       title="Top 10 Most Expensive Council Areas to Host",
       subtitle="Based on cleaned melb_airbnb data")
```

## Shiny App

```r
launch_app()
```

App lets hosts filter by Council Area, Room Type, and Max Price slider. Interactive histogram shows price distribution, value boxes show listings count, avg price, top council. Hover shows aggregated bin counts (fixed from individual squares).

## Conclusion

Location (LGA) and property type strongly affect price. Hosts in Bayside/Stonnington can charge more for Entire home/apt. Shared rooms are rare and can have skewed averages - filter to single LGA for fair comparison.
